name: PSD3 Readiness, Consent Stress and VoP Match Rate
outcome: Three independent computations over an open-banking payment-initiation surface. Step 1 scores the six-domain PSD3 and PSR readiness rubric and produces a prioritised gap table (art-14). Step 2 stresses the consent-lifecycle state machine by Monte Carlo and checks the ASPSP availability threshold (sim-07). Step 3 analyses batch payee name-match rates at the declared strictness (art-11). Each step computes from its own declared inputs; the order is analytical. The graph dates PSD3 readiness at 2027-06-01.
